record: Rule-6 mutants for pre-started waiting sessions in packages/polaris-dossier (owner direction POLARIS-DOSSIER-WAITING-SESSIONS-2026-10-08; candidate polaris-dossier-local-agent-mode v1.2, REQ-polaris-generation-035 as amended there), re-run after review-408 round 1 (docs/reviews/R-PR408-WAITING-SESSIONS-1-RAW.md). The population is every refusal, guard and disclosure predicate of the wait-mode code, re-derived from the files at `commit`: each `if`, conjunct and ternary in waiting-sessions.ts, the wait-mode paths of session-handover.ts (sessionCommands, waitingAllowedTools, the two waiting prompts, START_DISCLOSURES, startSessions, handOver and deliverReview), the continuity items of render.ts and the await exit codes and stdin wiring of cli.ts. Each predicate has one mutant below, or one entry in `notMutated` with its reason. M1-M40 and S1-S10 are the earlier record's mutants (S1, S5 and S7 re-anchored on the moved source); F1-F8 and N2 cover the round-1 repairs; F4a-F4af cover the predicates finding 4 named and the rest of the population. `builderMutants` covers the v1.2 builder, the v1.1 builder's peel and delegation, and the recorder's v1.2 entry. Not authority.

measuredOn.commitNote: Each mutant names the commit it ran at. The first pass ran at 4f668cf9 in list order through F4m; the vitest run of F4n hung (dropping the opening gate leaves the wait slice without a deadline) and the runner stopped at its timeout. e1b15896 adds two aggregate cases to waiting-sessions.test.ts, which F8g and F8h had survived at 4f668cf9; it changes no other subject (compare the digests). The second pass re-ran F8g, F8h and F4n onward there. Adding test cases cannot revive a mutant the first pass killed. F4ac survived there (the dropped design build refusal still refused, later, at stage write); fc9fa3aa adds one assertion that the refusal is not at stage write, changes no other subject, and F4ac alone was re-run there. Where an id ran twice its last run is the one listed.

method: Each mutant replaces `old` with `new` (exactly one occurrence, else not applied) in one file of the worktree at its `commit`, runs `command` from the worktree root, then restores the file byte for byte. A mutant is killed when the replacement applied and the command exits nonzero, or `killed (timeout)` when the command was still running after 300 s (second pass; the process group is killed). `failedTests` is read from Vitest's summary line, null where the first pass logged none. The tree under packages/ was clean after the second pass (`treeCleanAfter`).

notMutated.why: Unreachable through any input: decideExecutionRule returns the sec-3 arm for every role but 'authoring' (packages/polaris-dossier/src/execution-rule.ts, `if (inputs.role !== 'authoring') return sec3(...)`), and the inventory brief is built with the inventory role. A mutant would survive by construction.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts awaitSession: the clause `directoryArg.split('/').some((part) => part === '.' || part === '..')`
notMutated.why: Subsumed by the clause before it: path.normalize removes every '.' and '..' segment of an absolute path, so a path holding one never equals its normalisation and is already refused. M21 removes both clauses together and is killed; this clause alone cannot change an outcome.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts awaitSession: the clause `expected === undefined` in the brief re-hash
notMutated.why: Subsumed by the clause after it: a sha256 hex digest is never undefined, so `sha256(bytes) !== expected` refuses the same inputs. M16 removes that clause and is killed.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts sessionDirectoryRefusal: the `lstatSync` catch (a session directory that does not exist)
notMutated.why: No write can follow it: with the arm removed, a missing directory still fails `realOrNull` in await (refused at stage submit) and the `mkdirSync` of the round in a delivery (refused at stage write), so only the stage word changes, never whether anything is written.

Reachable only when lstat has just succeeded and realpath then fails (the entry or an ancestor removed or made unreadable between the two calls); no test can place an input there without fault injection into node:fs.
Equivalent without it: readRecord of the session-0 prompt record finds no file, so the function returns null either way.
Reachable only by a race: sessionDirectoryRefusal has just resolved the same path's real path, so realpath fails here only if the directory vanished in between.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts deliverToWaiting: the catch around the round's writes
notMutated.why: Exercised, not mutated: the two 'counts no delivery record' tests drive it (the run's delivery record already exists, so `wx` fails) and assert its reason, 'round 1 could not be delivered'. A mutant rethrowing instead would change that reason, but none was run.

notMutated.predicate: waiting-sessions.ts awaitSession: `if (!result.ok) return refuse('check', ...)` after checkInventory and after reviewCheck
notMutated.why: Forwarding only: the refusal is the check's own, tested in check and review suites; the waiting code adds no predicate there, and since F5 a submission reaches the check only as bounded JSON.

notMutated.predicate: session-handover.ts startSessions: `if ('stage' in context) return refuse(...)` and `if (!built.ok) return refuse(built.stage, built.reason)`
notMutated.why: Forwarding only: sessionContextOf's statement refusal is killed through M12; buildInventoryBrief refuses only when SEC-3 cannot be quoted from the records root's adopted doctrine, which the fixture sources read from the real checkout, where it can.

notMutated.predicate: session-handover.ts startSessions: the catch around the directory and record writes
notMutated.why: An I/O failure arm (a write refused by the file system after every check passed); no input reaches it without fault injection.
Reachable only by a race: handOver calls deliverReview only after waitingReviewSession returned a session for the same run and kind.

notMutated.predicate: session-handover.ts handOver: the clauses `isReviewKind(rest.kind)` and `RUN_ID.test(path.basename(target))` in the delivery condition
notMutated.why: Equivalent without them: for a kind outside the two, or a path that is not a run, waitingReviewSession finds no waiting prompt record and returns null, so the call falls through to sessionPrompt either way.
Not a predicate on input: a conversion of a stream chunk to bytes. The reader's bound is mutated (F5d).

notMutated.predicate: cli.ts: the `await` and `session-prompt` argument grammar (`--stdin` or `--fresh` given twice, other than one positional argument)
notMutated.why: Usage errors (exit 2) raised before any wait-mode code runs; they guard the command line's shape, not a write, a read or a disclosure, and are not mutated in this record.
